title: Vision SAE Feature Quality vs. Language SAE Feature Quality: A Parallel Comparison
original_idea: Train SAE on DINO-ViT-S/8 via ViT-Prisma and matched SAE on GPT-2 Small via SAELens. Rate top 50 features by interpretability (1-5). Compare mean scores, sparsity, and reconstruction quality.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Relevant for multimodal safety, but the comparison is descriptive rather than directly actionable. Intermediate importance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires learning two different toolkits (ViT-Prisma and SAELens), training two SAEs, and manual interpretability rating of 100 features. High effort for 30hrs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two models, two toolkits, manual rating, three comparison metrics. Broad scope despite seemingly simple framing.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
